sequences.summary: The six-action general-purpose level-100 alignment documented by Icy Veins 7.55: Air Anchor, Drill, Barrel Stabilizer, Chain Saw, Excavator, and Full Metal Field. This compact drill teaches the fixed backbone before adding resource and weave decisions.

startPrompt.text: Begin the tool alignment with Air Anchor, kupo!

mistakePrompt.text: The tool alignment changed. Reset and begin again with Air Anchor.

completionPrompt.text: Tool alignment complete. The rotation backbone is now on cooldown together.

steps.advice: Air Anchor begins the alignment and generates Battery.
steps.timing: First GCD.
steps.commonMistake: Delaying it shifts every future Air Anchor.

steps.advice: Drill follows so its two-charge recast starts immediately.
steps.timing: Second GCD.
steps.commonMistake: Starting with filler leaves a tool unused.

steps.advice: Barrel Stabilizer prepares both Full Metal Field and a free Hypercharge.
steps.timing: Weave after Drill before Chain Saw.
steps.commonMistake: Using it during Overheat crowds the short GCD window.

steps.advice: Chain Saw continues the tool block and grants Excavator Ready.
steps.timing: Next GCD.
steps.commonMistake: Delaying it shifts the 60-second line.

steps.advice: Excavator immediately consumes the transformed Chain Saw button.
steps.timing: Directly after Chain Saw.
steps.commonMistake: Letting the proc expire loses damage and Battery.

steps.advice: Full Metal Field completes the block and is already a guaranteed critical direct hit.
steps.timing: After Barrel Stabilizer has granted the proc.
steps.commonMistake: Using Reassemble on it has no effect.

sequences.summary: A training-dummy baseline built from the Icy Veins 7.55 general tool alignment and Hypercharge prerequisites. It omits the raid tincture. The Double Check and Checkmate pattern is a low-latency reference; preserving the GCD is more important than forcing every weave.

startPrompt.text: Prime Reassemble, then open with Air Anchor. Tools first, burst second, kupo!

mistakePrompt.text: The baseline order changed. Reset so the tool cooldowns can be aligned cleanly.

completionPrompt.text: Baseline opener complete: tools aligned, Queen deployed, and five Blazing Shots fired.

steps.advice: Prime Air Anchor with Reassemble so the first eligible 660-potency tool receives the guaranteed critical direct hit.
steps.timing: Use shortly before the first GCD; the five-second duration is generous enough for a clean pull.
steps.commonMistake: Using it before Full Metal Field wastes the buff because Full Metal Field cannot consume Reassemble.

prompt.text: Prime the first tool with Reassemble, then begin with Air Anchor.

steps.advice: Air Anchor begins the documented general-purpose alignment and generates 20 Battery.
steps.timing: Use as the first GCD and avoid delaying it.
steps.commonMistake: Opening with filler causes every later 40-second Air Anchor to drift.

steps.advice: Spend the second Reassemble charge on another eligible 660-potency tool.
steps.timing: Weave before Drill without clipping.
steps.commonMistake: Holding both charges at cap wastes recharge time; spending it on a combo shot wastes potency.

steps.advice: Lower Double Check below two stored charges before Hypercharge.
steps.timing: Use in the spare weave slot before Drill.
steps.commonMistake: Entering Hypercharge with two or more charges forces overcap as Blazing Shot reduces its recast.

steps.advice: Drill is the second tool in the baseline and starts its 20-second charge recovery early.
steps.timing: Use immediately after Air Anchor.
steps.commonMistake: Sitting on two Drill charges loses future charge recovery.

steps.advice: Barrel Stabilizer belongs between Drill and Chain Saw in the general alignment.
steps.timing: Weave here while the normal 2.5-second GCD provides room.
steps.commonMistake: Using it inside Overheat crowds a 1.5-second weave window.

prompt.text: The tool block is established. Barrel Stabilizer now bridges Drill into Chain Saw.

steps.advice: Lower Checkmate below two stored charges before Hypercharge.
steps.timing: Use alongside Barrel Stabilizer only when latency permits a clean double weave; otherwise use the next normal window.
steps.commonMistake: Clipping a GCD to force the double weave costs more than moving Checkmate.

steps.advice: Chain Saw is the third main tool and grants Excavator Ready.
steps.timing: Use immediately after the Barrel Stabilizer weave.
steps.commonMistake: Delaying Chain Saw shifts Excavator and the entire 60-second tool line.

steps.advice: Continue preparing Double Check for the coming Hypercharge window.
steps.timing: Use in the normal weave window before Excavator.
steps.commonMistake: Starting Hypercharge with two or more charges creates forced overcap.

steps.advice: Excavator follows Chain Saw and adds another 20 Battery.
steps.timing: Use while Chain Saw is transformed; do not insert filler between them.
steps.commonMistake: Missing the 30-second proc loses a full 660-potency GCD and 20 Battery.

steps.advice: Deploy Queen once the opening tools have produced at least 50 Battery.
steps.timing: Weave after Excavator so Queen begins attacking during the opening burst.
steps.commonMistake: Summoning before 50 Battery is impossible; holding to 100 in the opener can waste buffed pet damage.

steps.advice: Spend the second Checkmate charge so both charge skills are below two before Hypercharge.
steps.timing: Use the remaining normal-GCD weave slot before Full Metal Field.
steps.commonMistake: Entering Hypercharge with two stored Checkmate charges causes a forced overcap.

steps.advice: Full Metal Field completes the opening tool block.
steps.timing: Use after Barrel Stabilizer's proc is active and after Queen is deployed.
steps.commonMistake: Do not spend Reassemble here; Full Metal Field is already a guaranteed critical direct hit.

steps.advice: Apply Wildfire only after the tools are safely on cooldown.
steps.timing: Double weave with Hypercharge in a normal GCD window when latency permits.
steps.commonMistake: Applying Wildfire before the tool block encourages an early Hypercharge that delays core tools.

prompt.text: The core tools are down. Begin the Wildfire and Hypercharge burst.

steps.advice: Enter Hypercharge immediately after Wildfire.
steps.timing: Confirm Air Anchor, Drill and Chain Saw are unavailable and charge skills are below two charges.
steps.commonMistake: Hypercharging while a tool is due within roughly eight seconds causes tool drift.

steps.advice: Begin the five-shot Overheat sequence.
steps.timing: Keep the 1.5-second GCD rolling.
steps.commonMistake: Trying to double weave between Blazing Shots clips and drifts the rest of the rotation.

prompt.text: Overheat begins. One weave at most between each Blazing Shot.

steps.advice: Spend one Double Check charge in this short window.
steps.timing: Only one weave belongs between Blazing Shots.
steps.commonMistake: Double weaving here may still fit five shots but pushes every later tool.

steps.advice: Use the second Blazing Shot immediately.
steps.timing: Treat the Overheat sequence as a fast, even rhythm.
steps.commonMistake: Hesitating can lose a stack before the ten-second window ends.

steps.advice: Alternate to Checkmate.
steps.timing: Use one charge and return directly to Blazing Shot.
steps.commonMistake: Using the same charge skill repeatedly can leave the other capped.

steps.advice: Use the third Blazing Shot.
steps.timing: Maintain the 1.5-second cadence.
steps.commonMistake: Looking ahead too far on the ribbon can make the current short GCD late.

steps.advice: Spend the recovered Double Check charge.
steps.timing: Use only one weave.
steps.commonMistake: Forcing this weave on high latency is optional; preserving GCD timing is more important.

steps.advice: Use the fourth Blazing Shot.
steps.timing: Continue without pausing.
steps.commonMistake: Allowing the normal combo or a tool to interrupt consumes time from Overheat.

steps.advice: Spend the recovered Checkmate charge.
steps.timing: Use only one weave and prepare for the final shot.
steps.commonMistake: Clipping here can push the final Blazing Shot or the next tool.

steps.advice: Finish with the fifth Blazing Shot.
steps.timing: Exit Overheat cleanly and return to whichever tool or combo action is next.
steps.commonMistake: Continuing to predict Blazing Shot after five stacks means the forecast state is wrong.

prompt.text: Five Blazing Shots complete. Return to tools and combo filler.
